notes:
MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): status changed from blocked SDK_BUG to pass. The author found a real gate defect: the gate's hardware view had no approval authority, so an R3 driver failed G6.CRASH (MHS.SAFETY.APPROVAL_REQUIRED). The gate is now its own approval authority for an R3 view over the fake backend only (MHS/changes/WAVE-B1.md); the reviewer re-ran the gate and recorded the pass. The author's notes as written at the time of the block follow. (After the registry rebuild the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.)

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): status changed from pass to blocked SDK_BUG. The package drives an ISEG high-voltage supply, which is R3 (MHS/spec/04-safety.md); the author had declared R1, the card's floor. At R3 the reviewer added the safe-state action x-cap.silab-bonn.output_off.v1 (the upstream off(), the native call of the e-stop) as the independent stop G3 asks for. The gate cannot exercise an R3 hardware driver yet: its behaviour checks open a hardware session, which at R3 needs an authenticated approval authority the gate does not configure (G6.CRASH, MHS.SAFETY.APPROVAL_REQUIRED). Until the SDK gives the gate a test approval authority this package stays blocked; it is otherwise complete. The author's notes follow.

Package drives one device class of the repository: basil.HL.iseg_hv:IsegHV, an ISEG SHQ/NQH high-voltage supply over RS-232. Checked on the fake backend only; model-authored and unreviewed, nothing ran on hardware. NOT COVERED: the physical HV enable/disable (the front-panel HV-ON switch, KILL_ENABLE and the interlock) and the polarity switch; the e-stop lowers the target voltage to 0 V through the upstream off() and does not open a physical switch, so a deployment needs the front-panel switch and the interlock as the authoritative stop. NOT COVERED: the current trip (L/LB/LS), the status word, the module status and the software voltage limit v_lim are not exposed. NOT COVERED: the other device classes of the repository (the Tektronix oscilloscope layers, the sequencer and the register layers). DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's decision family-config with helper ScpiDriver cannot express the ISEG protocol, whose commands the upstream assembles at run time from a letter, the channel number and a value (U1, D1=100, V1=5, W=1); the package is a direct Driver over the upstream class, with native.py opening basil.TL.Serial for the hardware backend. The maximal voltage (V_MAX, returned in the module identifier) and the channel count (n_channel, from the init configuration) are operator_required bounds; site-limits.example.json fills them with example values. The fake implements only methods that exist on IsegHV.
